# payment-sslcommerz

> Generated by `scripts/docs-generate.ts` from `modules/payment-sslcommerz/registry-item.json` and its skill. Do not edit this file. Run `pnpm docs:generate` to update it.

A payment provider on the SSLCOMMERZ hosted checkout for cards and wallets in Bangladesh; needs an SSLCOMMERZ store.

## Environment variables

| Variable | Services | Optional | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SSLCOMMERZ_MODE` | api | yes | Which gateway host to use: `sandbox` for https://sandbox.sslcommerz.com or `live` for https://securepay.sslcommerz.com. Optional, and it defaults to `sandbox`, so a deploy that never set it cannot take real money; any other value fails the env check. |
| `SSLCOMMERZ_RECEIPT_EMAIL` | api | required when `PAYMENT_PROVIDER=sslcommerz` | Required while PAYMENT_PROVIDER lists sslcommerz, and may stay blank under any other provider. A real mailbox you own, e.g. payments@yourdomain.com. SSLCOMMERZ requires cus_email on every session and mails its own receipt to it. A provider is handed an opaque payment reference and never learns the payer's address, so this is the one address it can name. |
| `SSLCOMMERZ_STORE_ID` | api | required when `PAYMENT_PROVIDER=sslcommerz` | Required while PAYMENT_PROVIDER lists sslcommerz, and may stay blank under any other provider. Your SSLCOMMERZ store id, from the merchant panel: register a sandbox store at https://developer.sslcommerz.com, or use the live store SSLCOMMERZ issues you. Read from apps/api/.env in local dev (saasaloy env, then pnpm env:setup) and from a Workers secret (`wrangler secret put SSLCOMMERZ_STORE_ID`) in production. Unset, the provider reports `card` as unavailable and `create` answers method_unavailable; set but wrong, the gateway refuses the session and it surfaces as provider_error with the gateway's own failedreason. |
| `SSLCOMMERZ_STORE_PASSWORD` | api | required when `PAYMENT_PROVIDER=sslcommerz` | Required while PAYMENT_PROVIDER lists sslcommerz, and may stay blank under any other provider. The store password issued with SSLCOMMERZ_STORE_ID, sometimes called the API password. It is sent on the session-open POST, on every validation call and on every refund, so a deployed Worker holds it as a secret (`wrangler secret put SSLCOMMERZ_STORE_PASSWORD`), never in wrangler.jsonc. |
